## Summary

Addresses the two open PRs from the last 5 days with the most unresolved review comments.

---

### PR #85 — "feat: HTTP resilience — timeouts, exponential-backoff retry" — 17 unresolved threads

**Remaining fix: remove unreachable dead code in `fetchWithRetry`**

Sourcery-ai and gemini reviewers both flagged that the `throw lastAbortError ?? new Error(...)` statement after the retry loop is unreachable. On the final attempt, an `AbortError` is re-thrown directly inside the loop (`attempt < maxAttempts` is false → falls through to `throw error`), so the loop never exits naturally. The `lastAbortError` accumulator variable was also unused other than in this dead throw.

- Remove `let lastAbortError: unknown` declaration
- Remove `lastAbortError = error` assignment in retry branch
- Replace trailing unreachable throw with `throw new Error('fetchWithRetry: exhausted all attempts')` (now correctly reachable when all attempts return retryable statuses — guards the TypeScript control-flow return)

All 20 existing http-resilience tests continue to pass.

> Other PR #85 threads (caller signal preservation, body draining, HTTP-date Retry-After, parameter validation, unstubAllGlobals, no-op test, hardcoded timeout string) were already addressed in PR #95.

---

### PR #94 — "Add design.md: Visual identity and design system specification" — 11 unresolved threads

All 11 structural/consistency issues fixed:

| Issue | Fix |
|-------|-----|
| Missing mandatory file header comment (chatgpt-codex P1) | Added Purpose / Why / Info flow / Note header |
| Color tokens don't match implementation (gemini) | Updated to actual dark-theme palette: gold `#c9a227`, fuchsia `#e8006a`, dark backgrounds matching `+layout.svelte` CSS vars |
| Typography tokens use `system-ui` instead of actual fonts (gemini) | Updated fontFamily to actual web fonts: `Fraunces` (display), `Bricolage Grotesque` (body), `Barlow Condensed` (labels) |
| `button-tertiary` missing from YAML components block (gemini + chatgpt-codex) | Added `button-tertiary` with transparent bg, gold border/text |
| Input border-width not in tokenized component (chatgpt-codex) | Added `borderWidth: "1px"` and `borderStyle: "solid"` to `input` component |
| Input focus state missing from YAML (chatgpt-codex) | Added `focusBorderColor: "{colors.primary}"` to `input` component |
| Shapes section says "4px on inputs" but token is 8px (gemini + chatgpt-codex) | Fixed prose to "8px on inputs" matching `rounded.md` |
| Layout max-width 1200px vs 1240px in implementation (gemini) | Fixed to `1240px` to match `+layout.svelte` and `+page.svelte` |
| Mobile min text size (16px) conflicts with label token (14px) (chatgpt-codex) | Added `fontSizeMobile: 16px` to label token so the mobile constraint is machine-readable |

## Test plan

- [x] `npm test tests/unit/http-resilience.test.ts` — 20 tests pass, 0 failures
- [x] `design.md` is a new documentation file with no runtime effect
